content.short: Hyperbolic is a decentralized AI network on Solana that aggregates global GPU power for low-cost AI computation.
content.description: Hyperbolic is a decentralized AI infrastructure network built on Solana, designed to democratize access to high-performance computing resources. By aggregating idle GPU capacity from providers worldwide, the platform provides a scalable and cost-effective alternative to centralized cloud providers for AI inference and model training. This decentralized approach ensures that developers and researchers can access the compute power needed for complex AI operations without high costs. Hyperbolic is building the foundational layer for a transparent and permissionless intelligence economy.
